title: Stale/replayed sync frames can inflate advertised stratum label via -EALREADY path
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/time_sync.c:332-338. Accepted -EALREADY branch overwrites s_stratum even without fresh SFN advance; link-authenticated-but-stale upstream frames claim higher quality label gaining adoption preference. Impact bounded (range enforced 0..3, wall clock untouched, gated elsewhere) but fix belongs here: refresh stratum only when set_sfn returned 0 or never increase current.
close_reason: s_stratum refresh now gated on lichen_time_sync_set_sfn()==0 fresh SFN advance; -EALREADY (stale/duplicate frame) propagates err without touching any state. Stale link-authenticated frames can no longer inflate or degrade the advertised label. Variant chosen: strict fresh-advance gate, consistent with set_sfn's strictly-advancing freshness model and simpler than monotonic-label tracking.
